_comment: Survival on the roam map (LevelLoader 'Roam survival', 'waves': 1). The map, gold and Lives are level_roam's (Assets/Scenes/Levels/level_survival.unity, a copy of level_roam.unity); the run starts with the scene's Enemies (1 Red Round, 2 Red Squares) and the pack AI. No clock and no money goal: it lasts until the last Life. Enemies come in waves out of the player's sight: the first after wave_first seconds, then every wave_every seconds (x wave_every_scale per wave, down to wave_every_min); wave n brings wave_size + wave_growth x (n - 1), wave_round_share of them Red Rounds, while fewer than max_enemies are alive. Eaten gold comes back elsewhere after gold_respawn seconds (small to diamonds, now and then a Life). The gold eaten goes into the wallet; the time survived is the best survival time on the main menu.
guide:
SURVIVAL: stay alive as long as you can.
More enemies come in every wave, and the gold keeps coming back: eat it, it all goes to your wallet.
